༄༅/ /rgyud dang grub chen bla ma'i dgongs don thun drug gi rnal 'byor ji ltar bya ba'i tshul bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyud dang grub chen bla ma'i dgongs don thun drug gi rnal 'byor ji ltar bya ba'i tshul bzhugs/

na mo gu ru badzra dha ra ye/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kun/ / gcig bsdus bshes gnyen gar rol pa/ /bla ma rdo rje can zhabs la/ /btud nas thun drug rnal 'byor bshad/ /de yang sngags pas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig dang sdom pa dag par byed pa'i thabs ni de rnams la nyin zhag rer bsngo bgrang byed dgos shing*/ de la rigs lnga'i dam tshig rnams thun drug tu bsten dgos par rgyud rgya gzhung du ma dang*/ rje'i rtsa ltung rnam bshad/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i ṭīkka/ mkhas grub rje'i rnal 'byor rol pa'i dga' ston sogs las 'byung ba ltar gal che ba zhig go /des na 'dir rigs lnga'i sdom bzung gi don gyi snying po thun drug gi rnal 'byor dang sbyar nas nyams su len tshul bsdus pa ni/ bla ma mchog gsum thams cad la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ldan cing*/ /sdug bsngal kun las thar ba dang*/ /bde ba mchog dang mi 'bral zhing*/ /nye ring chags sdang dang bral shog /mdun gyi nam mkhar yid 'phrog seṅge'i khri/ /sna tshogs padma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng*/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid/ /rnam pa khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang sngon po/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis/ /rdor dril bzung nas dbyings phyug ma la 'khyud/ /sna tshogs dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /'ja' tshon lta bu'i 'od kyi gur khy-im dbus/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs gnas gsum du/ /yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /rang bzhin gnas nas bla ma rdo rje 'chang*/ /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyis bskor ba/ /spyan drangs dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs gnyis med gyur/ /gang gi drin gyis zung 'jug bde chen sku/ /snyigs dus skad cig nyid la stsol mdzad pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i bla ma rje/

/rdo rje can zhabs padmor phyag bgyi'o/ /ji snyed phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ /dngos bshams yid sprul nam mkha' gang ba dang*/ /bdag lus longs spyod dge ba'i tshogs dang bcas/ /rje btsun bla ma khyod nyid mnyes phyir 'bul/ /bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum sogs dang*/ sdig ltung kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang*/ /chos 'khor bskor phyir rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ /dge kun rdo rje 'chang dbang thob pa dang*/ /rje btsun bla mas rjes su 'dzin phyir bsngo/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi/ /'phrin las ngur smrig gzugs kyi rnam rol te/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa sgrub pa'i khur bzhes pa/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal bas phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs mchod pa bas/ /gang zhig bsten cing mchod pa khyad 'phags zhes/ /rab bsngags dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ /'di phyi'i mchog thun legs tshogs thams cad kyang*/ /khyod nyid tshul bzhin bsten pa'i rjes 'gro bar/ /gsungs phyir bdag gi sgo gsum bya ba kun/ /khyod mnyes 'ba' zhig sgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar gsol bas bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi/ yi ge gsum las 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /dkar dmar mthing gsum rim dang cig car du/ /byung nas thim pas sgo gsum byin brlabs te/ /bla ma spyi bo'i gtsug tu sa mā dzaḥ rang la thim pas dbyer med bdag nyid kyang*/ rdo rje 'chang gyur rdo rje dril bzung nas/ /rdor dbyings ma dang lhan cig mnyam par sbyor/ / bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dge tshogs bcas/ /mar gyur sems can don du rab bsngo zhing*/ byams dang snying rje btang snyoms mi 'jigs sbyin/ /rtag tu goms pas 'gro kun bskyang bar bya/ /so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa gsum/ /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong srung ba dang*/ /rgyal ba'i mdo sngags chos tshul ma lus pa/

/mgon de'i dgongs pa ji bzhin bzung bar bya/ /mdor na rang don tsam la mi lta bar/ /gzhan don tshul bzhin byed 'dod lhag bsam gyis/ /gang la gang 'dul 'tshams pa'i thabs bstan nas/ /bla med byang chub mchog la 'god par shog /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*/ /zhes sogs kyang brjod par bya'o/ /skabs 'dir yan lag gzhan dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang zhor la bkod cing 'jug sdom 'dzin dgos pa'i nges pa yang med mod/ 'dzin par spro na/ yan lag bdun pa'i mjug der ram/ 'dir yang rung ste/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs sam/ yang na/ sngon gyi bde bar gshegs rnams kyis/ /sems bskyed bslab pa bzung ba ltar/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /byang chub spyod la bslab par bgyi/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /zhes mdor bsdus nas bya'o/ /de dag rigs lnga'i sdom bzung dang sbyar na/ gong gi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang 'og gi sdom pa gsum la bslab par khas blangs pa ni rnam snang gi rigs kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa la slob pa dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang du bskyed nas mchod de rang la bstims nas rdo rje 'chang yab yum du bsgoms pa'i sgo nas rdor dril 'dzin pa ni mi bskyod pa dang*/ lus longs spyod sogs gzhan la gtong zhing byams pa dang btang snyoms tshad med sgom pa ni rin 'byung dang*/ mdo sngags kyi dam chos ma lus par 'dzin pa ni 'od dpag med dang*/ bla ma la phyi nang gi mchod pa'i tshogs 'bul ba ni don grub kyi rigs kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa la slob par byed pa'i tshul te/ gzhan rnams ni de dag gi yan lag go / thun drug tu byed tshul ni/ nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /zhes sogs rin 'byung gi dam tshig gi skabs su 'byung ba ltar gzhan rnams la sbyor ba yin pas/ thun drug ni nyin lan gsum dang mtshan lan gsum te dus drug tu de ltar bsngo bgrang byed dgos pa gzhung gi dgongs pa yin kyang*/

da lta'i gang zag gis de ltar ma nus tshe lan gsum mam/ ma tha gcig byas na'ang legs par sems so/ /de lta bu'i nyams len ni rgyud dang grub chen spyi'i dgongs pa yin pas nyams len phal pa gzhan las khyad par du 'phags so/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho las 'ongs pa'i/ /don bzang rin chen 'phreng mdzes 'di/ /skal ldan kun gyi dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa dag byed rgyan mchog yin/ /zhes pa 'di'ang 'ga' zhig gis snga mo nas bskul bas rkyen byas te/ shākya'i dge slong rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshul can bshad sgrub ming can gyis co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba'o/ / ༈ rje btsun mi la la brten pa'i thun drug gi rnal 'byor dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba ni/ na mo su ma ti kīrti ye/ 'dir rje btsun mi la'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i thun drug gi rnal 'byor mdor bsdus gsol 'debs dang bcas pa zhig dam pa'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar bshad par bya ste/ spyir thun drug gi rnal 'byor ni rgyud sde gong ma gnyis kyi dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gnang ba'i bka' drin gsum ldan sogs kyi bla ma zhig dang sbyar nas byed dgos pa gzhung gi dgongs par mngon yang*/ rje btsun mi la dang sbyor bar 'dod na de dang rtsa ba'i bla ma gang mos ngo bo dbyer med du bsgoms na legs te/ gzhan du na cung ma 'brel bar 'gyur ro/ /der ma zad rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po dang sbyor yang rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med du mdzad dgos so/ /'dir grub chen mi la dang sbyor gsung ba bzhin byed pas/ thun drug gi nyams len rigs lnga'i sdom bzung gi go rim dang 'brel dgos shing*/ sdom bzung las/ sngon du sems bskyed dang*/ de nas rnam snang*/ mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung*/ 'od dpag med/ don grub kyi dam tshig rnams rim bzhin bshad pas go rim de ltar du yang rung mod/ 'jug pa bde chen go rim de bzhin nges med la don rnams tshang ba'i tshul gyis brjod na 'di lta ste/

/bla ma mchog gsum thams cad la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /mar gyur sems can kun don phyir/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /sems can thams cad bde ldan cing*/ /sdug bsngal kun dang bral gyur cig /bde thob nyid dang mi 'bral bar/ /chags sdang bral ba'i gnas thob shog /de nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar brag ljon me tog gis/ /mdzes pa'i dbus su pad sdong rgyas pa'i rtser/ /rin chen khri steng nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma kun dang dbyer med pa'i/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun mi la'i zhabs/ /sku mdog sngo sangs zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /phyag g.yas sor mo snyan gyi rtsa bar 'dzin/ /g.yon pa lte 'og mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len/ /ras dkar gos gyon skyil krung phyed stabs bzhugs/ /gnas gsum rdo rje gsum mtshan hūṃ yig gi /'od kyis 'og min mngon par dga' sogs nas/ /rje btsun mi la rgyal ba zhi khro yis/ /bskor ba spyan drangs dbyer med gcig tu gyur/ /brtson pa phul du byung ba'i snying stobs kyis/ /dka' ba brgya phrag dang blangs tshe gcig la/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku brnyes grub pa'i dbang*/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid dang dbyer med pa'i/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun chen po la/ /srid zhi'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchog tshogs dang*/ /bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs bcas te 'bul/ /sdig ltung kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang*/ /chos 'khor bskor phyir bskal brgyar rtag bzhugs gsol/ /dge kun rdo rje 'chang dbang thob phyir bsngo/ /rgyal dang de sras thugs rje'i zlos gar nyid/ /grub dbang rnam rol gang la gang 'dul gyis/ /zhing 'dir rgyal ba'i mdzad pa sgrub pa can/ /rje btsun rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje 'chang gis rab 'byams rgyal ba

las/ /gang gi zhabs pad bsten cing gus mchod pa/ /lhag par bsngags pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ /dbyer med rje btsun chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma grub chen mi la dang*/ /tha dad med pa'i tshul du mos gus kyis/ /spyi bor bsten no bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes dang*/ gdungs dbyas dang 'brel ba zhig gsungs 'dug pa ltar de yin khul du/ spro na/ mgon khyod kyis ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal rgyu/ /gtan spangs nas bde ba'i dpal brnyes kyis/ /da ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal myong 'gyur ba'i/ /phran bdag cag rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /rje khyod kyis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal kun/ /rab spangs te zhi ba'i bde thob kyis/ /da mtha' med 'khor bar khyams 'gyur ba'i/ /phran bdag cag rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon khyod kyis rang bde tsam don gnyer/ /yongs dor nas gzhan don mthar phyin mdzad/ /da rang don tsam la rjes chags pa'i/ /phran bdag cag rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /rje khyod kyis rgyud dang grub chen gyi/ /srol man ngag mthar thug nyams bzhes kyis/ /da man ngag nyams len ma mchis pa'i/ /phran bdag cag rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon khyod kyis brtson pa shugs drag gis/ /tshe gcig la grub pa mchog brnyes kyis/ /da le lo dman la zhen gyur pa'i/ /phran bdag cag rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /rje khyod kyis grogs med gcig pu yis/ /dben gnas su ting 'dzin bsgoms mthar phyin/ /da 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba'i rgyar chud pa'i/ /phran bdag cag rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon khyod kyis ting 'dzin zas bsten te/ bde drod kyi gos bzang mchog gyon gyis/ /da tha mal gyi zas gos la chags pa'i/ /phran bdag cag rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /rje khyod kyis snang srid chos kun kyang*/ /zab chos kyi dbyangs su sgrogs mdzad

kyis/ /da 'chal gtam brjod pas dus 'da' ba'i/ /phran bdag cag rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon khyo kyis rang lus lha skur gzigs/ /ngag bzlas brjod yid kyis bde stong sgom/ /da sgo gsum tha mal snang zhen can/ /phran bdag cag rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /rje khyod kyis skye shi bar do gsum/ /sku gsum gyi lam du bsgyur mdzad kyis/ /da skye 'chi bar do'i 'khor lo can/ /phran bdag cag rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor gsol na dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /kun 'dus kyi rnal 'byor dbang phyug che/ /khyod nyid kyis tshe rabs kun tu yang*/ /'bral med du rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyas bsdus gnyis gang byed kyang*/ de ltar gsol bas bla ma'i gnas gsum las/ /bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum rim can dang*/ /cig car byung nas bdag nyid gnas gsum du/ /de bzhin thim pas sgo gsum byin brlabs te/ /rang gi spyi bor tshangs pa'i bu ga nas/ /zhugs nas snying khar byang sems dbyer med las/ /rang nyid rdo rje 'chang gi skur gyur te/ /rdor dril bzung nas dbyings phyug ma dang sbyor/ /bdag lus longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ /mar gyur sems can rnams la yongs btang zhing*/ /so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa kun/ /srog gi phyir yang mi 'da' bsrung bar bya/ /rgyal ba'i mdo sngags chos tshul ma lus pa/ /de yi dgongs pa ji bzhin 'dzin pa dang*/ /gang 'tshams thabs kyis 'gro ba thams cad kyang*/ /bla med go 'phang mchog la 'god par shog /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*/ /zhes sogs kyang brjod par bya'o/ /tshul 'di la rigs lnga'i sdom bzung gi don rags pa tshang ba yin te/ de yang thun drug gi rnal 'byor sngon ma'i skabs su bshad pa ltar sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /thun drug gi rnal 'byor rgyas pa nyams su len rgyu byung na shin tu legs pa yin mod/ tshul de ma lcogs na 'di ltar mdor bsdus pa'i sgo nas dran shes pa sten rgyu byung na'ang nyams len phal pa gzhan rnams las ni khyad par du 'phags zhes bshad pa ltar yin te/

'di la rigs lnga'i sdom bzung gi don gyi snying po tshang bas dam tshig dang sdom pa dag byed kyi thabs mchog tu 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /ces pa 'di yang*/ rgyal dbang bdun pa'i chos kyi thugs sras rigs pa smra ba ar dkar zhabs drung ang smon dbyangs can gzhon nu zhes bgyi bas thag ring nas bskul ba ltar/ /co ne'i slob dpon pa shāka btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis khong gi gsung bzlog ma nus par co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo/ /maṅgalaṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ rgyud dang grub chen bla ma'i dgongs don thun drug gi rnal 'byor bya ba'i tshul bzhugs/ - PAGE 324-- PAGE 323-- PAGE 316-
